name: Koboshi
source:
Koboshi is a catgirl robot. As a soldier of the Meowtis Empire National Security Force, she's been loaned to [url=https://vndb.org/c1788]Shinju[/url] in order to track down and arrest [url=https://vndb.org/c1786]Hanabi[/url]. However, she's adorably inept, always falling down or shorting out. But her clumsy behavior endears her to [url=https://vndb.org/c49076]Ibuki[/url], enough to make her mechanical nature a non-issue.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/919344-lets-meow-meow/faqs/35340]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
